method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Tommy 说州方将和解，主因是 Ramsby 承认销毁证据的录音
facts.anchor: “Mostly it was the recording of Ramsby admitting to destroying evidence.

facts.fact: Gemma 播放的录像里赤道房整个房间缓缓旋转（对应午夜电话里的马达声）
facts.anchor: The entire room begins to turn in a slow circle.

facts.fact: Colm 透露母亲死时抱着他，让他爬上床，他直到早晨才发现她已死
facts.anchor: “She was holding me when she died. She told me to climb in bed with her.

facts.fact: Colm 承认 Ed 店里的木锥在召唤他，他把它拿走了
facts.anchor: “The wood awl in Ed’s shop called to me—it was like I had to take it.

facts.fact: Colm 承认总是确保 Dustin 是那个没有不在场证明的人（栽赃）
facts.anchor: I always made sure Dustin was the one without an alibi.

facts.fact: Colm 说 Hattie 的电话让幻象消失、帮他停手
facts.anchor: You helped make her go away. She made me do what I did, and you helped it stop.

facts.fact: Colm 推搡 Hattie，她从堤岸跌向下面的岩石
facts.anchor: he shoves her and she’s falling off the bank toward the rocks below.

facts.fact: 一声如冬天树木断裂的脆响伴着火光，Tommy 开枪击中 Colm
facts.anchor: There’s a sharp crack like a tree snapping in winter and a spurt of flame.

facts.fact: Colm 走进海浪，最终没入波浪消失
facts.anchor: then slips under the waves and is gone.
